          Elevate Your Travel with Avios

          Earn Avios and unlock exclusive benefits with the only Avios-earning credit card in Canada.

          Card Highlights

          Earn and Redeem Avios Easily

          Collect Avios on everyday spending2, and use them on British Airways and oneworld partner flights, seat upgrades, hotel stays and other exclusive items3.

          Access Great Travel Benefits

          Enjoy exclusive perks like 10% British Airways flights4 + other flight discounts, companion vouchers, concierge services, and more.

          Get Broad Travel and Protection Insurance

          Experience peace of mind with insurance coverage for flight delays8, emergency medical7, and more.

          Earn Avios Faster

          3 Avios

          Earn 3 Avios for every dollar you spend on British Airways purchases2

          2 Avios

          Earn 2 Avios for every dollar you spend on dining and food delivery2

          1 Avios

          Earn 1 Avios for every dollar you spend on all other qualifying purchases2

          Take Off Sooner

          Flight Discounts

          Get 10% off British Airways flights every time you book and pay with your card4.

          Companion Voucher

          Earn a Companion Voucher when you spend $30,000 CAD annually. Take a companion with you OR fly solo for a 50% discount on the Avios fare of your reward seat ticket5.

          Easy Redemption

          Redeeming your Avios for flights couldn’t be easier. Simply book online at ba.com or by phone at 1-800-452-1201 to fly with British Airways or on oneworld partner airlines3.

          Discover Travel with Avios

          Turn everyday spending into extraordinary adventures. Earn Avios with every purchase and watch your travel dreams take flight2.

          Flights

          Use your Avios towards Reward Flights with British Airways or any of the oneworld partner airlines to almost 1,000 destinations worldwide3.

          Upgrades and Partial Payments

          Avios can be used towards premium cabin upgrades or to reduce the price of selected regular cash bookings on British Airways flights3.

          Holiday Bookings

          Get even more out of your Avios by using them for hotels, dining, shopping, and other travel experiences3.

          Enhance Your Travel with Visa Infinite

          Access a world of curated experiences and personalized service.

          Travel

          Access the Visa Infinite Luxury Hotel Collection and enjoy benefits like free stays, discounts, room upgrades and free breakfast at over 900 Visa Infinite Luxury Hotel Collection properties around the world. Visa Infinite card holders also have discounts with Park n’ Fly, Viator and Via Rail.

          Food and Wine22

          Indulge in curated dining events from some of the finest restaurants around Canada with the Visa Infinite Dining Series. Also, cardholders are treated to exciting wine country benefits like curated tours, elevated tasting experiences, preferred pricing and more24.

          International Data22

          Stay connected in 175+ countries with discounted GigSky data using your eligible Visa card. Visa Infinite cardholders get 1GB/15 days complimentary plan, plus 20% off all plans on eSIM-compatible devices.

          Complimentary Concierge

          Whether you’re looking to book travel plans, get a restaurant recommendation or find that perfect gift, Visa’s complimentary concierge service will do the research for you and help save you time, with 24/7 availability to help make your experience extraordinary.

          Why Choose an RBC Travel Credit Card?

          RBC Mobile App

          Manage your bills, set up mobile pay, and see all your transactions all on our award winning mobile app.

          Fraud Protection

          If you’ve taken care to protect your credit card, you’re covered against fraudulent or unauthorized use of your card—both in-store and online.

          Balance Protector

          BalanceProtector Max can protect your travel credit card balance when you need it most. Help prepare for the unexpected with this optional coverage which you can cancel at any time.
